purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: Conakry
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Conakry is the special administrative zone with multiple communes; national land and cadastre functions sit with the Ministry of Urbanism, Housing and Territorial Planning / Direction Nationale des Domaines et du Cadastre.
registryBasis: City-scoped legal evidence includes Guinea’s official urban-land framework referring to the Zone Spéciale de Conakry and cadastral/title documents, plus the public title-registration procedure requiring application to the mayor of the relevant commune and the national Conservation Foncière. This confirms a legal registration mechanism for the Conakry communes, not a current complete or digitized parcel register.
findings: The city-specific legal framework references the Zone Spéciale de Conakry and cadastral/title documentation; the current public service describes title registration via the mayor of the relevant commune and the national conservation authority. The 2026 national modernization statements are future-work evidence, not proof of completed city coverage. Search-result snippets identified ministry and national land-platform pages, but no parcel API/page was directly fetched and no anonymous parcel polygons were verified.
